title: Stark effects of the fluorescence spectra in InP core and InP/ZnSe core/shell quantum dots under an external electric field
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43955-43964
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06323J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ning Du, Hongshan Chen
The distinct spectral shift behaviors—pure quadratic, linear, and mixed quadratic linear—are linked to the intrinsic electron–hole separation in InP/ZnSe QDs, which can be tailored by adjusting the thickness of the core or shell layer of QDs.
